Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/fuzz_init_path.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"data/size","code":"fwrite(data, size, 1, fp);","note":"The raw fuzz input is written verbatim to a temporary file that will be opened by libdwarf."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_generic_init.c","function":"dwarf_init_path","line":123,"var":"path","code":"return dwarf_init_path_dl(path, true_path_out_buffer, true_path_bufferlen, groupnumber, errhand, errarg, ret_dbg, 0, 0, 0, error);","note":"dwarf_init_path forwards the attacker-controlled file path into the generic initializer that opens and inspects the file."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_generic_init.c","function":"dwarf_init_path_dl","line":214,"var":"path","code":"fd = open(name, O_RDONLY | O_BINARY);","note":"The temporary file is opened and becomes the object that libdwarf parses for debug-link and build-id metadata."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_generic_init.c","function":"final_common_settings","line":149,"var":"dbg->de_path","code":"dbg->de_path = strdup(file_path);","note":"The opened file path is stored in the Dwarf_Debug object and later reused as the base executable path."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_generic_init.c","function":"set_global_paths_init","line":101,"var":"dbg","code":"res = dwarf_add_debuglink_global_path(dbg, \"/usr/lib/debug\", error);","note":"Initialization installs a global debug directory, enabling the later debug-link path search logic."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_debuglink.c","function":"dwarf_gnu_debuglink","line":760,"var":"dbg->de_path","code":"pathname = (char *)dbg->de_path;","note":"When debug-link processing runs, it retrieves the stored executable path from the debug object."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_debuglink.c","function":"dwarf_gnu_debuglink","line":827,"var":"pathname / debuglink_path","code":"res = _dwarf_construct_linkedto_path((char **)dbg->de_gnu_global_paths, dbg->de_gnu_global_path_count, pathname, *debuglink_path_returned, &debuglink_fullpath, *crc_returned, *buildid_returned, *buildid_length_returned, paths_returned, paths_count_returned, &errcode);","note":"The stored path and extracted debuglink name are passed into the path-construction helper that builds candidate debug-file locations."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_debuglink.c","function":"_dwarf_construct_linkedto_path","line":462,"var":"joind.js_originalfullpath","code":"_dwarf_pathjoinl(&joind.js_originalfullpath, &joind.js_basenamesimple);","note":"The helper joins path components using _dwarf_pathjoinl; the crash occurs in that join routine when it reads the last byte of an empty target buffer, producing the reported global-buffer-overflow read."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fuzz_init_path.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json
